name: Buzzer alarm
summary: Beep patterns (slow, fast, SOS) on a buzzer while everything else keeps running. For tank-full, too-hot or door alarms.
use: Alarm alarm(8); setup: alarm.begin(); loop: alarm.update(); if (full) alarm.start(Alarm::FAST);

points.note: Each call checks whether it's time for the next beep or pause, so the buzzer never stops the rest of the program.
